headline.purpose: One top-level title per application surface; -0.015em tracking, text-wrap: pretty.

title.purpose: Cards, panels, dialogs, and focused-workspace headings.

body.purpose: Forms, tables, descriptions, and operational copy; prose caps at 72ch.

label.purpose: Metadata, table headers, field labels. Rendered at natural case; the 0.05em tracking is an opt-in Latin-only treatment.

mono.purpose: Job IDs, template identifiers, URIs, payloads, printer addresses, trace values. Opens to 1.65 line-height inside the Evidence Canvas.

stat.purpose: At-a-glance metric values, tabular numerals. Secondary metric rows step down to headline size.

action.purpose: Button and control labels; 0.012em is optical correction, not style.

shadows.name: subtle-surface
shadows.purpose: Sticky action bars and preview paper when a border alone is insufficient.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, and anchored floating content over white surfaces.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Side drawers; depth is cast away from the attached edge.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover feedback on the primary button; rose equivalent at 0.24 alpha for danger. Absent at rest, pressed, and disabled.

shadows.name: backdrop-dialog
shadows.purpose: Dialog backdrop. Drawers use rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.42); the full-screen paper preview uses 0.72.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Color and background state changes on buttons, rows, and links.

motion.name: field-standard
motion.purpose: Field border, halo, and background transitions.

motion.name: surface-spatial
motion.purpose: Nav rail slide and the active-marker scale-in — motion that explains spatial origin.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global kill switch under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Every animation has an instant fallback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action-blue control for direct task progression. Flat at rest; the lift is hover-only.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.45rem; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #1e66f5); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 6px); background: var(--primary, #1e66f5); color: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.012em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #1654d1); border-color: var(--primary-hover, #1654d1); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(30, 102, 245, 0.30); } .ds-button-primary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1e66f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White outlined control for the alternative action in a pair.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--neutral-border-strong, #d1d5db); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 6px); background: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--neutral-text, #374151); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.012em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--neutral-subtle, #f0f0f0); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1e66f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Consequence Rose. Destructive or physically consequential confirmation only.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--danger-action, #9f1239); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 6px); background: var(--danger-action, #9f1239); color: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.012em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-action-hover, #830e2e); border-color: var(--danger-action-hover, #830e2e); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(159, 18, 57, 0.24); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1e66f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Full-opacity disabled state — a blocked control still has to be readable, because why it is blocked is the next question.
components.css: .ds-button-disabled { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--neutral-border, #e5e7eb); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 6px); background: var(--neutral-subtle, #f0f0f0); color: var(--neutral-text-muted, #6b7280); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.012em; opacity: 1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard 38px field. Focus shifts the border and adds a translucent halo on the field itself.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid var(--neutral-border-strong, #d1d5db); border-radius: var(--rounded-md, 6px); background: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--neutral-text, #374151); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--neutral-text-muted, #6b7280); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--neutral-text-muted, #6b7280); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary, #1e66f5); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1e66f5) 38%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--state-danger-text, #991b1b); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: The pill reserved for filtering and toggling; exposes aria-pressed. Never a primary button.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 34px; padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; margin-right: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--neutral-border-strong, #d1d5db); border-radius: var(--rounded-pill, 9999px); background: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--neutral-text-muted, #6b7280); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #1e66f5); color: var(--primary, #1e66f5); } .ds-chip.is-selected { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #1e66f5) 40%, var(--neutral-border, #e5e7eb)); background: var(--state-info-surface, #eff6ff); color: var(--primary-hover, #1654d1); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #1e66f5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Job Status Badge
components.description: Outlined pill carrying the literal server status. Border and text share one contrast-safe color; the fill stays transparent.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 9px; margin-right: 0.5rem; border: 1.5px solid currentcolor; border-radius: var(--rounded-pill, 9999px); background: transparent; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-status--success { color: var(--status-success, #166534); } .ds-status--unverified { color: var(--status-unverified, #92400e); } .ds-status--failed { color: var(--status-failed, #9f1239); }

components.name: Device Status Indicator
components.description: Device or service condition — a separate axis from job status. A dot plus the condition as text, so meaning never rests on color.
components.html: IdleOfflineUnknown

components.css: .ds-metric { display: inline-grid; gap: 0.35rem; min-width: 11rem; padding: 1rem; margin-right: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--neutral-border, #e5e7eb); border-radius: var(--rounded-lg, 8px); background: var(--neutral-surface, #ffffff); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric__value { color: var(--neutral-deep, #1e1e2e); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric__label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; color: var(--neutral-text-muted, #6b7280); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-metric__dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentcolor; } .ds-metric--attention { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--state-warning-text, #92400e) 35%, var(--neutral-border, #e5e7eb)); background: var(--state-warning-surface, #fef3c7); color: var(--state-warning-text, #92400e); } .ds-metric--attention .ds-metric__value, .ds-metric--attention .ds-metric__label { color: var(--state-warning-text, #92400e); }

components.name: Evidence Canvas
components.description: The one sanctioned dark surface: a line-numbered editor for authored template bodies and JSON payloads.
components.css: .ds-canvas { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0, 1fr); min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--canvas-edge, #334155); border-radius: var(--rounded-lg, 8px); background: var(--canvas-ink, #111827); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-canvas__gutter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--canvas-edge, #334155); background: var(--canvas-gutter, #0f172a); color: var(--canvas-line, #94a3b8); user-select: none; } .ds-canvas__field { margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem; color: var(--canvas-text, #e5e7eb); caret-color: var(--canvas-caret, #93c5fd); white-space: pre; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-canvas:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary, #1e66f5); } .ds-canvas[data-invalid] { border-color: var(--state-danger-text, #991b1b); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; width: 200px; padding: 1rem 0.75rem; background: var(--nav-bg, #1e1e2e); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav__link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.38rem 0.6rem 0.38rem 0.85rem; border-radius: var(--rounded-sm, 4px); color: rgba(205, 214, 244, 0.8); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav__link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 3px; height: 60%; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: var(--primary, #1e66f5); transform: translateY(-50%) scaleY(0); opacity: 0; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-nav__link:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav__link.is-active { background: rgba(30, 102, 245, 0.15); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__link.is-active::before { transform: translateY(-50%) scaleY(1); opacity: 1; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--nav-active, #89b4fa); outline-offset: 0; }

narrative.overview:
PrintOps feels like a well-kept clinical notebook: precise, calm, and trustworthy. Every element is a deliberate record, placed for rapid scanning rather than decoration. The interface recedes behind the operator's task while keeping physical-output consequences unmistakable.

The system is light-first and restrained. Familiar system typography, compact controls, quiet borders, and flat reading surfaces suit long shifts under fluorescent hospital lighting. Brand character comes from disciplined blue accents, exact spacing, bilingual resilience, and honest operational states — not visual spectacle. Every route is built from the same anatomy: a bounded measure, a ruled header, a body of surfaces, and an optional detail and footer region beneath it. Two pages of the same kind should differ in content, never in skeleton.

The notebook has two papers. Most of the product is light: white surfaces on page gray, read at a glance. Where the operator authors or inspects exact machine text — a template body, a webhook payload — the surface flips to the Evidence Canvas, a dark, line-numbered field that says this is literal, and whitespace counts. Motion is limited to short state feedback and spatial transitions that explain where an overlay or drawer came from, with a global reduced-motion fallback. The visual system rejects flashy SaaS gradients, terminal-dense data walls, generic component-library styling, and dark application chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first surfaces tuned for clinical workstations, with one sanctioned dark canvas for authored code
A single route anatomy — bounded measure, ruled header, body, detail, footer — shared by every page
Flat-by-default depth with elevation reserved for overlays, drawers, and consequential controls
System-native sans-serif typography with monospace reserved for technical evidence
One action-blue family, plus separate axes for job status and device condition
Restrained surface corners with pills reserved for compact status and filtering
Keyboard-complete controls, 44px touch targets, forced-colors support, and equal English/Thai support

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is the only non-semantic accent. Its restraint makes focus, selection, and the next safe action immediately recognizable.

rules.name: The Dilution Rule
rules.body: New shades of an existing role are produced with color-mix() against --primary, --neutral-surface, or a state token — never typed as a fresh hex. A literal color in a stylesheet is a claim that no existing token could express it, and that claim is almost always false.

rules.name: The Literal Status Rule
rules.body: Never merge, rename, or imply a server status through color alone. Preserve the literal label, pair it with a contrast-safe outline or explicit text, and keep UNVERIFIED visually distinct from FAILED.

rules.name: The Two Axes Rule
rules.body: Job status and device condition are different vocabularies and must never borrow each other's colors or components. StatusBadge is for jobs; StatusIndicator and StatusDot are for devices and services.

rules.name: The Consequence Color Rule
rules.body: Rose signals destructive or physically consequential action, not ordinary emphasis. Routine primary actions remain blue or neutral.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Use system fonts only. Do not load display fonts or create a decorative headline layer.

rules.name: The Evidence Layer Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where the exact string matters operationally; ordinary prose and labels stay sans-serif.

rules.name: The Thai Integrity Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and letter-spacing are Latin-only treatments and are opt-in, never structural. Table headers, field labels, fieldset legends, and nav group headings all render at natural case with no tracking — the earlier uppercase treatment was removed because it does nothing for Thai and breaks its glyph clusters. The caps prop on Text exists for Latin strings the product controls; it must never be applied to localized copy.

rules.name: The Wrapping Rule
rules.body: Operational strings wrap; they do not disappear. Cells, descriptions, and labels use overflow-wrap: anywhere and text-overflow: clip rather than an ellipsis, so a truncated identifier can never be mistaken for a complete one.

rules.name: The One Task Per Mobile View Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, show the list or the focused maintenance task — not both side by side. Navigation back to the parent context must remain explicit.

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive targets are at least 44px on coarse pointers and below 1024px, even when their desktop visual footprint remains compact. Text inputs additionally take font-size: max(1rem, 16px) there, because iOS zooms anything smaller.

rules.name: The One Skeleton Rule
rules.body: A new page composes PageScaffold, PageHeader, PageSection, and PageFooter. It does not invent a competing page frame, and it does not add another global stylesheet to correct one.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and page regions are border-defined at rest. Add a shadow only when the element floats above, moves over, or must be distinguished from the current plane.

rules.name: The Directional Depth Rule
rules.body: Drawers cast depth away from their attached edge; centered overlays use ambient depth. Shadow direction must explain spatial origin.

rules.name: The Rule Line Rule
rules.body: Within a page, separation is a 1px border in Border Gray — under the header, above the detail and footer regions, between table rows, around every panel. Depth is for things that leave the page; rules are for things that structure it.

rules.name: The Restrained Corner Rule
rules.body: Use 4–8px corners for ordinary surfaces and controls, 12px for floating overlays, and full pills only for status or filtering — never for primary buttons or large containers.

dos: Do compose new pages from PageScaffold, PageHeader, PageSection, and PageFooter, and new surfaces from the primitives exported by components/ui/index.ts.
Do reference tokens as var(--token) and derive new shades with color-mix() against an existing token.
Do use White reading surfaces on Page Gray, with 1px rules for in-page structure and shadows only for surfaces that leave the page.
Do keep job status and device condition on separate components and separate color axes.
Do preserve literal operational states, especially UNVERIFIED, and pair every status color with text, outline, shape, or icon.
Do keep proof generation and physical printing visibly separate; generating or refreshing a proof must never trigger output.
Do require a distinct confirmation for every physical print and block printing while printer readiness is offline or unknown.
Do set min-width: 0 on flex and grid children and minmax(0, 1fr) on grid tracks, and let operational strings wrap instead of truncating.
Do maintain visible focus, keyboard operation, 44px touch targets, reduced-motion behavior, forced-colors support, and bilingual EN/TH resilience.
Do use mobile cards or focused next-step views when a dense desktop table or split workspace would compete for attention.
donts: Don't write a literal hex, rem, or shadow value into a stylesheet when a token expresses it. #1e66f5 is var(--primary).
Don't add another global override stylesheet to correct a page. Fix the shared component, or scope the fix to the feature that owns it.
Don't invent a competing page frame, a fifth breakpoint for one surface, or a one-off font size.
Don't use color gradients, decorative glows, oversized display type, or animation as decoration. The auth graph-paper field is the single sanctioned exception and does not generalize.
Don't extend the Evidence Canvas beyond authored code and payload editing. Application chrome, dashboards, tables, and forms stay light.
Don't create terminal-dense dashboards or expose expert payload controls as the default operator workflow.
Don't uppercase or letter-space anything that can hold localized copy — table headers, field labels, legends, nav headings, or badge text.
Don't use color as the only communicator, or lower contrast for secondary operational text.
Don't place shadows on ordinary table rows, section headings, or static cards.
Don't use pill-shaped primary buttons or large rounded containers; pills belong to compact status and filtering.
Don't dim a disabled control until its label is unreadable — a disabled state still has to explain itself.
Don't truncate critical identifiers or safety copy without a discoverable full value.
